notes:
Need to search first.I couldn't write any of the Ezekiel 19 notes, because I wasn't able to read a single source page.

When I tried to open the Enduring Word commentary on Ezekiel 19, the fetch was refused: the tool only opens pages that have already appeared in search results, and I hadn't run a search yet. I then started a batch of searches covering Enduring Word, Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary, Gill, Precept Austin and the NET Bible notes. Before any results came back, I hit the limit on tool calls for this turn, so nothing came through.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, give a URL for every point and not fill gaps from my own knowledge. With no pages read, I have nothing I can honestly put under any verse. Notes written from memory with guessed URLs would break those rules.

If you ask again in a new message, I'll start with searches and then read the pages they return:
- **Main reading of each verse:** Enduring Word, Ellicott, Pulpit Commentary and Gill on BibleHub or StudyLight, and Precept Austin.
- **Differences between Protestant traditions:** the Methodist, Lutheran, Reformed and Pentecostal sites on your list, if they have anything on this chapter.
- **Other views:** NET Bible notes and Bible Odyssey for modern scholarship, and New Advent (Haydock or the Church Fathers) for Catholic and Orthodox readings.

I'll then write the notes as "v. 1:", "v. 2:" and so on, with a URL after every point, and leave out anything I can't find.
